corruptions.text: PLAN: First, identify William Corcoran Eustis as the personal assistant to General John J. Pershing during World War I. Next, use this information to determine that he was chairman of the inauguration committee for Woodrow Wilson's first inauguration in 1913 and started the Loudoun Hunt in 1894.

descendants.hop_2: FINDING: William Corcoran Eustis was chairman of the inauguration committee for Woodrow Wilson's first inauguration in 1913 and started the Loudoun Hunt in 1894.
